maddeler.e:
انفصمت (form VII)
# اِنْفَصَمْتُ (infaṣamtu) /in.fa.sˤam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
# اِنْفَصَمْتَ (infaṣamta) /in.fa.sˤam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
# اِنْفَصَمْتِ (infaṣamti) /in.fa.sˤam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَصَمَ (infaṣama)
# اِنْفَصَمَتْ (infaṣamat) /in.fa.sˤa.mat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
